HRI.headline: Why Herc Holdings Rocketed Over 20% Today
HRI.description: Herc Holdings surged over 22% after delivering a strong Q3 earnings beat with adjusted EPS up 76.1% and raising full-year guidance. The company successfully integrated H&E Equipment Services and is capitalizing on mega-projects in data centers and oil & gas, while higher interest rates drive customers to lease rather than buy equipment. Trading at reasonable valuations relative to peers, Herc appears well-positioned for continued industrial growth.

HRI.headline: Herc Holdings (HRI) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
HRI.description: Herc Holdings reported Q3 2026 earnings of $3.91 per share, significantly beating the consensus estimate of $3.08 and representing a 26.95% earnings surprise. The equipment rental supplier also exceeded revenue expectations at $1.36 billion. Despite strong quarterly results, HRI shares have underperformed the S&P 500 year-to-date, declining 14.3% versus the market's 12.1% gain. The company holds a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating based on favorable earnings estimate revisions.
